skills.observableOutcome: Counts groups of up to five objects using one-to-one correspondence.
Recognizes common two-dimensional shapes by their visible attributes.
Recognizes that plants need water and sunlight to grow.
Identifies the initial sound in familiar English words.
Identifies the first sound in familiar spoken English words.
Recognizes familiar words that share the same ending sound.
Understands and selects familiar English words in everyday contexts.
Counts pictured objects accurately using one-to-one correspondence.
Recognizes and continues simple number and visual patterns.
Solves simple joining and separating problems using quantities.
Recognizes common two-dimensional shapes and their visible properties.
Identifies age-appropriate facts about familiar living things and the surrounding world.

activities.prompt: Ali has 3 mangoes. How many mangoes does he have?
مع علي ٣ حبات مانجو. كم حبة مانجو معه؟
activities.feedbackIncorrect: عدّ كل حبة مرة واحدة ثم حاول مرة أخرى.

activities.prompt: Which shape has three sides?
أي شكل له ثلاثة أضلاع؟
activities.feedbackIncorrect: انظر إلى عدد أضلاع كل شكل ثم حاول مرة أخرى.

activities.prompt: Which pair helps a plant grow?
أي زوج يساعد النبات على النمو؟
activities.feedbackCorrect: ممتاز! يحتاج النبات إلى الماء وضوء الشمس.
activities.feedbackIncorrect: فكّر فيما يحتاجه النبات ليعيش وينمو.

activities.prompt: Which word begins with the /s/ sound?
أي كلمة تبدأ بصوت حرف س؟
activities.feedbackCorrect: صحيح! كلمة سمكة تبدأ بحرف س.
activities.feedbackIncorrect: انطق الكلمات ببطء واستمع إلى الصوت الأول.
